description: Use this when asked whether public NFT or digital-art records agree (creator, title, edition, contract, token). Pass a `question` and `evidence_items`. Returns AGREES / CONFLICT / SINGLE_SOURCE per field with a receipt. URLs are not fetched; no authenticity, ownership or price finding. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

examples.question: Do these public records agree on the creator and the edition?

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones.

data_classification.description: PUBLIC (default) or NON_PERSONAL_PUBLIC. Never send personal data.

episode_id.description: Optional: your own id to group related calls.

evidence_items.description: Records as they appear, each with a source_url (not fetched).

independent_operator_id.description: Optional: your operator id (recorded as a claim, not verified).

question.description: What you want to know about the records.

synthetic.description: Optional: true marks a test call.

name: evaluate_public_art_evidence
title: Check public art evidence
